## Why it matters

- The diversifier thesis is getting a real correlation budget: two L/S breakout books at 0.44 to each other and ~0 to the underlying is the portfolio-construction argument the whole series builds toward ([[2026-10-27-margincall4-l-s-breakout-portfolio-addition]] → 10y extension → validation → this). It echoes the edge-index architecture of [[2026-10-31-futako1013-17-edge-index-forward-first]] captured the same day.
- **Skepticism gates:** the short leg's t-score 2.19 sits well below the >3 bar the author himself quoted in his own validation tweet ([[2026-10-28-margincall4-overfitting-validation-dsr-pbo-walkforward]]) — the combined 3.67 is carried by the long leg. Combined Sharpe 1.18 after costs is far more modest than the 10y extension's 2.34 headline — same author, same method family, one week apart; the honest comparison is OOS-to-OOS. Win rate 40.2% confirms the breakout/trend profile (fat right tail, most trades lose). Self-reported, OCR cells approximate, stats fresh.
